none: PAS NLM-AAC3E2: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Pearl diademed bust draped and cu irassed right. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.9mm, Weight: 1.67gms, die axis: 12
